summary: Lead research for Routes MVP (transit routing/delivery optimization platform). Targets transportation providers, transit systems, and logistics companies in Ashtabula County and Northeast Ohio that could benefit from route optimization, transit planning, and delivery management tools.

leads.fit_rationale: Operates point deviation and door-to-door transit services. Route optimization tools would improve service efficiency and reduce travel times.
Coordinates transit planning across Northeast Ohio. Route optimization and transit planning tools would support regional mobility initiatives.
Specializes in less-than-truckload shipping and freight consolidation. Route optimization would improve delivery efficiency and reduce costs.
Major transit provider serving Cleveland and surrounding areas. Route planning tools could enhance service planning and optimization.
Multiple local trucking and logistics companies. Route optimization platform would benefit small carriers competing with larger firms.

branding_quality_assessment.notes: No visual-analysis JSON available yet; branding/layout assessment deferred until screenshot analysis report exists.

site_improvements: Add real-time route optimization with traffic and weather integration.

possible_issues: Route planning interfaces need clear map visualization—poor map integration hinders usability.
Without mobile optimization, drivers cannot access routes in the field.
Complex route data without clear presentation overwhelms dispatchers.

whitelabel_potential.reason: Route optimization platforms are highly white-labelable for transit agencies, logistics companies, and delivery services with custom branding.
